limits: Software boundaries and request flow, not a Loop execution graph. Local implementation and external qualification are separate.

views.title: Whole-system architecture
views.description: The engine includes governed solving, reusable intelligence, executable solutions and internal runtime services. Hosted delivery is one boundary, not the complete product.

components.title: Task and declared requirements
components.summary: Original objective, material and acceptance conditions.
components.detail: Intake preserves the task and declared authority. A service subscription does not supply execution permissions.

components.title: Practitioner solving
components.summary: Research, reason, build, test and revise.
components.detail: The Practitioner owns solutioning under a classified Loop. Reasoning and building are assignment purposes, not separate runtime types.

components.title: Four intelligence layers
components.summary: Context, Code, Runtime History and Solution, and User Feedback Intelligence.
components.detail: Search returns typed references; permission and identity checks precede loading. Complete all-layer hosted qualification remains open.

components.title: Solution Canvas
components.summary: Typed executable composition for subsequent inputs.
components.detail: A Canvas contains canonical Loops with compatible ports. Different member Loops may use different allowed modes.

components.title: Canonical Loop runtime
components.summary: One runtime for Practitioner, Intelligence and Solution roles.
components.detail: Definitions bind role profiles, modes, step profiles, conditions, budgets and typed connections. Passive stores and services are not Loop vertices.

components.title: Capabilities and engine adapters
components.summary: Intelligence Search and Retrieval, Web Research, and Custom Plugins.
components.detail: Model, harness, workspace, store and provider adapters are internal mechanics. Only an owning Loop's authority permits effects.

components.title: Verification and acceptance
components.summary: Checks decide acceptance; model confidence does not.
components.detail: Independent verification, failure review and recorded evidence are separate from production of a candidate.

components.title: Run History and improvement inputs
components.summary: Keep exact outputs, failures, provenance and unknown accounting.
components.detail: History supports playback and review. Automated improvement and promotion still need full integrated qualification.

components.title: Hosted intelligence delivery
components.summary: Website, authenticated protocol, subscriptions and selected bytes.
components.detail: Local service paths are tested. Fly.io and Supabase are the proposed hosted deployment; cloud adapters, signup and live payments remain unqualified.

views.title: Loop definition and runtime
views.description: This is a map of runtime components, not a graph of particular executing Loop instances. Role, relationship, mode, step profile and authority stay separate.

components.title: Versioned Loop definition
components.summary: Identity, typed ports and executable contract.
components.detail: The definition names the role profile, supported modes, conditions and required capabilities. Unknown or incompatible definitions refuse before work.

components.title: Role and step profiles
components.summary: Practitioner, Intelligence and Solution behavior presets.
components.detail: Profiles configure canonical Loops; they do not create a second runtime. Categories do not grant authority.

components.title: Restricted runtime context
components.summary: Capabilities, permissions and installed executors.
components.detail: A derived context may narrow authority, not expand it. Services and adapter objects are not graph vertices.

components.title: Canonical Loop
components.summary: Execute the declared steps and conditions.
components.detail: Starting, Spawned by, Queried by, Retrieved by and Connected from are relationships. Execution mode belongs to each Loop.

components.title: Exact effect approval
components.summary: Bind approval to the requested operation.
components.detail: Changing the effect requires a new decision. Prompt text and model confidence cannot approve an effect.

components.title: History and checkpoints
components.summary: Record progress, outcomes and resumable state.
components.detail: Publication, completion, acceptance and promotion remain different states. An uncertain external effect is not safely replayable.

views.title: Reasoning, building and adaptive solving
views.description: A Practitioner may reason, inspect, build and run experiments within explicit permissions. The purpose of an assignment does not grant its effects.

components.title: Task intake and materials
components.summary: Preserve requirements and the working material.
components.detail: Public solving binds the original task, selected files and request settings. Complete unified downloads and shared scoped views remain open.

components.title: Orientation and intelligence
components.summary: Find relevant context and available capabilities.
components.detail: Retrieval and source loading are separate. Offers, fetched content, native loading and helpful use are distinct observations.

components.title: Plan and assignments
components.summary: Choose a bounded course of work and its dependencies.
components.detail: Exact task decomposition and generic adaptive replanning require more qualification than the local fixture paths provide.

components.title: Typed decision engines
components.summary: Optional Jev, Circuit and compatible endpoints.
components.detail: The configured direct and harness-tool paths are tested locally. Automatic selection at every Practitioner branch is not implemented.

components.title: Capability and harness execution
components.summary: Invoke code, inspect data or delegate authorized work.
components.detail: Registered code may avoid a model call. An execution choice must satisfy its inputs, required effects and remaining allowance.

components.title: Assess and verify
components.summary: Check the result against the task.
components.detail: A response, process exit and accepted outcome are not interchangeable.

components.title: Continue, repair or finish
components.summary: Use observations, failure evidence and remaining authority.
components.detail: A failed check needs classification. A provisional terminal package must retain missing material and uncertainty.

views.title: Solution graph, execution and reuse
views.description: The solutioning process creates candidates. A Solution Canvas specifies what can run on another input; its publication and qualification have separate gates.

components.title: Typed Solution graph
components.summary: Contracts and relationships between member Loops.
components.detail: Ports must be compatible before execution. A pipeline does not have one execution mode for all its Loops.

components.title: Compile and bind operations
components.summary: Resolve exact operations and implementation identities.
components.detail: Do not infer executable behavior from a label, filename or prose.

components.title: Canvas execution
components.summary: Run supported members under their selected executors.
components.detail: Deterministic, hybrid and non-deterministic members need a compatible executor and exact authority; unavailable executors refuse.

components.title: Model invocation port
components.summary: Shared model gateway and cumulative session allowance.
components.detail: Text and typed decisions use the existing model session. No endpoint is a permission grant.

components.title: Independent checks
components.summary: Accept only the declared task outcome.
components.detail: Check failure, repair and verification are recorded separately. Provider qualification remains separate.

components.title: Standalone export
components.summary: Package code, tests and deployment recipes.
components.detail: Supported export paths are locally checked. A package must run without relying on its builder conversation.

components.title: Solutions space and later reuse
components.summary: Retain exact candidate and accepted solution references.
components.detail: The complete automatic publication-and-reuse lifecycle remains an integration gap.

views.title: Intelligence layers and memory
views.description: Four persistent intelligence layers share retrieval and record contracts. Runtime Memory is separate and scoped to one run; source formats do not create new layers.

components.title: Context Intelligence
components.summary: Facts, instructions, forms and reusable context.
components.detail: Versioned records are searched before selected bodies are loaded. Imported material remains candidate-only until review.

components.title: Code Intelligence
components.summary: Executable assets with contracts and provenance.
components.detail: Active code needs source identity, license, dependencies, effects, tests and independent admission.

components.title: Runtime History and Solution Intelligence
components.summary: Prior work, exact outputs, costs and verification.
components.detail: Recorded failures and missing accounting must remain visible. History does not automatically become a generalizable procedure.

components.title: User Feedback Intelligence
components.summary: Scoped advice, decisions and reviewed feedback.
components.detail: Feedback is subject to scope and authority. It cannot waive protected contracts.

components.title: Cross-layer search
components.summary: Typed references before large bodies.
components.detail: The actual installed catalogue determines what can be found. Hosted all-layer qualification remains incomplete.

components.title: Catalogue store contract
components.summary: Identity, namespaces, versions and atomic operations.
components.detail: Current adapters have distinct capabilities. Hosted PostgreSQL is not supplied by creating a Supabase account.

components.title: Runtime Memory
components.summary: A temporary note board for one run.
components.detail: It is not a fifth persistent intelligence layer or an independent authority.

components.title: Working, episodic, semantic and procedural memory
components.summary: Different record purposes and lifecycle rules.
components.detail: Memory kind is distinct from intelligence layer, record format and storage backend.

views.title: Retrieval stages and artifact delivery
views.description: Eligibility, candidate generation, ranking, selection and materialization are separate. The cloud index is a target deployment; the default local backend is not semantic embedding search.

components.title: Typed search requirements
components.summary: Query, layer, filters and caller scope.
components.detail: Required compatibility and permission constraints must not become merely soft ranking preferences.

components.title: Configured retrieval backend
components.summary: Lexical or vector stage with a typed handshake.
components.detail: Bindings check effects before factory use. Embedding spaces include exact model, revision, dimensions and normalization.

components.title: Fusion and ranking policy
components.summary: Combine eligible candidate rankings and explicit evidence.
components.detail: Ranking settings are configurable. Outcome evidence is not assumed to exist merely because a ranking term supports it.

components.title: Selected typed references
components.summary: Identity, revision, digest and metadata.
components.detail: Search does not silently materialize every result or qualify a candidate.

components.title: Authorize and load exact bytes
components.summary: Selected-body permission and integrity checks.
components.detail: Local file delivery is implemented; Supabase private bucket delivery remains an adapter task.

components.title: Harness materialization
components.summary: Prepare only the declared context and native layout.
components.detail: Current metadata offers and instruction files do not establish full native resource loading.

components.title: Iterative search and optional reranking
components.summary: Bounded alternative engines and search refinement.
components.detail: Agentic retrieval, learned routing and named external engines require their own integration and evaluation.

views.title: Engine wrappers and runtime configuration
views.description: Share typed contracts and authority rules across replaceable implementations. These are domain-specific ports, not one invented universal engine runtime.

components.title: Owning Loop and runtime context
components.summary: Task contract, capability needs and authority.
components.detail: A Loop asks for an operation; it does not gain permissions from a preferred engine.

components.title: Version, capability and effect checks
components.summary: An explicit installed binding before invocation.
components.detail: Unknown adapters refuse. Runtime negotiation chooses supported contracts; it does not invent conversions.

components.title: Retrieval binding
components.summary: Swap lexical and vector implementations.
components.detail: Each backend owns its declared stage and exact embedding space. Automatic arbitrary plugin installation is not supplied.

components.title: Model gateway and decision profiles
components.summary: Select configured model endpoints and explicit fallback.
components.detail: Users supply endpoints and credentials. Loop Engine does not launch or manage their model servers.

components.title: Harness adapter
components.summary: Native or custom execution under the assignment.
components.detail: Actual supported versions, observed native loading and hidden model calls require qualification.

components.title: Workspace and store adapters
components.summary: Confined files, commands and record operations.
components.detail: Shared interfaces do not erase differences in transactions, sandbox strength or availability.

components.title: Admission, accounting and evidence
components.summary: Record the route, attempts and unknown costs.
components.detail: A schema-valid response is not independent task acceptance.

views.title: Core capabilities and reusable code
views.description: The three public capability groups are Intelligence Search and Retrieval, Web Research, and Custom Plugins. Registered operations are called under classified Loops.

components.title: Intelligence Search and Retrieval
components.summary: Search, select and materialize governed records.
components.detail: Source format and vendor do not create new intelligence layers.

components.title: Web Research
components.summary: Source discovery and authorized retrieval.
components.detail: HTTP, browser and external-service choices need explicit adapters and effects; a discovered URL is not permission to fetch.

components.title: Custom Plugins
components.summary: Admitted skills, tools and extension bundles.
components.detail: File presence does not execute a plugin or grant authority.

components.title: Capability directory
components.summary: Versioned handshakes and registered operations.
components.detail: One named capability call can reach installed surfaces without adding task-specific branches.

components.title: Detection and correction families
components.summary: Typed conformance, duplicates, recovery, copy and address operations.
components.detail: Effects differ: a pure proposal is not a file mutation. Confidence and review bands remain explicit.

components.title: Candidate qualification
components.summary: Review executable code before active reuse.
components.detail: The producer cannot approve its own newly generated capability.

views.title: Verification, failure review and acceptance
views.description: Model output, a completed process, task acceptance and independent promotion are separate. No permission or secret boundary may be waived by a favorable review.

components.title: Candidate output and provenance
components.summary: Exact artifacts and declared claims.
components.detail: Retain the original task and output identity for every evaluation.

components.title: Contract matching and graders
components.summary: Deterministic checks and declared matching modes.
components.detail: Unknown, false and failed checks are distinct. A matching policy cannot relax unrelated authority.

components.title: Independent verification
components.summary: Separate evidence and task judgments.
components.detail: Route separation is optional only when declared and available; absence is recorded, not replaced with a fictional second provider.

components.title: Failed-check review
components.summary: Classify whether work, check or environment failed.
components.detail: A check revision still has to reject a known-wrong answer.

components.title: Accepted or provisional result
components.summary: Preserve verified outcomes or explicit missing work.
components.detail: Partial resolution includes assumptions and next actions without claiming verified completion.

components.title: Repository and release gates
components.summary: Structural rules, tests, negative controls and source binding.
components.detail: Passing a component suite does not qualify a hosted product or prove every source file correct.

views.title: Memory, records, history and telemetry
views.description: Keep temporary working state, persistent intelligence and operational accounting distinct. Privacy and unknown-accounting rules apply across all adapters.

components.title: Run-scoped state
components.summary: Temporary notes and current working context.
components.detail: Not automatically shared across tasks or written into reusable intelligence.

components.title: Managed records and catalogue
components.summary: Exact revisions, namespaces and approved writes.
components.detail: Managed note collections use the existing record operation boundary, not direct row edits.

components.title: Run History
components.summary: Events, checkpoints and output identities.
components.detail: Recorded producer claims are not independent verification. Failed and excluded work remains inspectable.

components.title: Model and operation accounting
components.summary: Physical calls, usage and implementation cost.
components.detail: Unknown usage and cost stay unknown. Complete learnable collection for every physical call remains open.

components.title: Playback and reports
components.summary: Inspect the saved run and its evidence.
components.detail: Replay does not authorize repeating committed external effects.

components.title: Service metering and privacy
components.summary: Durable acknowledged usage with tenant scope.
components.detail: Raw task bodies and model keys are not default telemetry; complete retention and export workflows remain open.

views.title: Resources, credentials and process lifetime
views.description: These components exist, but ordinary harness-lifetime integration is incomplete. Do not read this diagram as proof that every process is already resource-admitted or credential-brokered.

components.title: Scoped harness assignment
components.summary: Purpose, capabilities and separate effect authority.
components.detail: Reasoning may include explicitly authorized experiments; building may be read-only.

components.title: Local resource measurement
components.summary: Observe capacity and declared ceilings.
components.detail: Full pre-start reservation across every harness path remains integration work.

components.title: Credential leases
components.summary: Host-held authentication and scoped delegated use.
components.detail: A private key absent from a prompt is not isolated from an unrestricted process under the same user.

components.title: Harness process adapter
components.summary: Start, cancel and observe owned subprocesses.
components.detail: Models remain external endpoints. Starting a harness does not mean starting all its models.

components.title: Checkpoint and hibernation
components.summary: Preserve state and unresolved effects when suspending work.
components.detail: The full ordinary process lifecycle and resume integration remain incomplete.

views.title: Controlled improvement and experiments
views.description: Self-improvement is a Practitioner task that stages candidates for independent review. The complete autonomous cross-run cycle is not qualified by isolated optimizer tests.

components.title: Permitted prior evidence
components.summary: Outcomes, failures, exact configurations and consent.
components.detail: Do not collect private raw context merely because it could help optimization.

components.title: Candidate mechanisms and configurations
components.summary: Add or remove steps, context, tools and settings.
components.detail: No universal preference for fewer steps or smaller context. Preserve initial choices and explicit fallback priorities.

components.title: Frozen tasks and controlled comparisons
components.summary: Matched baselines, perturbations and exact denominators.
components.detail: Development, candidate acceptance and final holdout remain separate. Sampling is not exhaustive coverage.

components.title: Independent review and adoption policy
components.summary: Refuse premature generalized learned routing.
components.detail: A selector or generated capability cannot independently approve itself.

components.title: Qualified intelligence and rollback
components.summary: Version, admit or reject the candidate.
components.detail: Complete generation, promotion and later-task reuse remain a connected release requirement.

components.title: External experiments
components.summary: SoL-Pi, retrieval optimizers and decision-readout candidates.
components.detail: Research informs experiments; it does not install or qualify a new engine. SoL-Pi needs an explicit extension-capable Pi profile.

views.title: Client and server boundaries
views.description: Customers run the work. Loop Engine supplies permitted intelligence. Hosted identity, billing and storage still need separate integration qualification.

components.title: Customer environment
components.summary: Task files, Loop runtime and native harnesses stay here.
components.detail: A customer may use the full Loop Engine runtime or connect a supported client for retrieval only. Connecting a harness does not automatically govern its internal steps.

components.title: Intelligence service
components.summary: Authenticated search, exact artifact delivery and durable access records.
components.detail: The Python service has real local HTTP and Model Context Protocol checks. A hosted endpoint, production identity and provider billing qualification are separate release gates.

components.title: External services
components.summary: Identity, payments, hosted storage and optional model access.
components.detail: Supabase, Stripe and a website host are candidate integrations. Model calls are customer-authorized. A subscription does not grant model, file or execution authority.

edges.label: Optional authorized model or tool calls

views.title: Serving subsystem responsibilities
views.description: The serving and execution paths share typed contracts. They do not share unrestricted credentials, task folders or execution authority.

components.title: Local runtime and client
components.summary: Owns the task graph, permissions and selected assignments.
components.detail: Canonical Loops own governed execution. Native harnesses remain replaceable adapters. LangGraph is not a required runtime dependency.

components.title: Service adapters
components.summary: One durable domain behind web and protocol operations.
components.detail: Requests have explicit version, size, origin, deadline and scope checks. Supported protocol: 2025-11-25. Current-version and live identity interoperability are not inferred.

components.title: Harness preparation
components.summary: Selected instructions and resources enter a confined workspace.
components.detail: Exact provisioning and file integrity have local checks. Complete remote retrieval into an actual native harness, observed loading and task acceptance still need combined qualification.

components.title: Intelligence Search and Retrieval
components.summary: References first; lexical and optional hybrid ranking.
components.detail: The default local service uses SQLite full-text search and deterministic hashed features, not a learned semantic embedding. Hosts can supply typed backend bindings and ranking settings. Named external engines still need adapters and qualification.

components.title: Access and qualification
components.summary: Tenant grants, exact source identity, revocation and metering.
components.detail: Access is rechecked at use. Payment does not promote an intelligence candidate. Host-attested review is labeled separately from independent source qualification.

components.title: Catalogue and artifact storage
components.summary: Durable records and immutable bodies have different duties.
components.detail: Local SQLite supports atomic read-set batches and restart. Private hosted buckets and shared Postgres deployment are not qualified by the embedded database tests.

components.title: Run History and verification
components.summary: Keep outcomes, failures and exact output references.
components.detail: Recorded execution, task acceptance and independent qualification remain distinct. Raw customer files and prompts are not automatically service telemetry.

components.title: Candidate improvement
components.summary: Evaluate proposed changes before independent promotion.
components.detail: AutoRAG, memory utility learners and deferred optimizers are candidates, not installed production policies. Keep existing authority, held-out evaluation and rollback obligations.

views.title: A retrieval and delivery request
views.description: Follow the actual serving boundaries. Finding a reference, accepting a selected digest and releasing bytes are separate operations.

components.title: Versioned request
components.summary: Query, result limit or exact selected item; caller credential outside arguments.
components.detail: Request JSON cannot choose a tenant, override an account or supply server write authority. Unsupported fields and protocol versions refuse.

components.title: Authenticate and narrow scope
components.summary: Durable key, or verified issuer, signature, audience and token scope.
components.detail: External token permissions intersect durable principal scopes. Token tenant claims do not determine tenancy. Configured key endpoints are bounded and cannot redirect.

components.title: Current principal and grants
components.summary: Recheck revocation, entitlement and exact item disclosure.
components.detail: An issued principal is bound to durable records. A stale key, subject or grant does not retain earlier access. Billing management requires a separate non-default scope.

components.title: Search permitted metadata
components.summary: SQLite lexical search or bounded local hybrid ranking.
components.detail: Returns typed provisioning_item_binding/v1 references with identity, source and digests. The transport revalidates the initial grant revision before releasing metadata. Bodies are not loaded by this query.

components.title: Select an immutable reference
components.summary: Pin identity and expected digest before requesting the body.
components.detail: A digest mismatch refuses before body disclosure or a new usage charge. A caller request identity binds a retry to the same effect.

components.title: Qualified, bounded body read
components.summary: Reauthorize, verify bytes and enforce inline or download limits.
components.detail: Larger UTF-8 bodies use a separately authorized download route. Bucket delivery and arbitrary binary bundle support remain separate integration work.

components.title: Atomic usage acknowledgment
components.summary: Compare current authority revisions and commit one idempotent usage record.
components.detail: An uncertain commit is not success. HTTP and protocol retries share the same durable request identity. A response timeout does not prove the write was cancelled.

components.title: Deliver exact material
components.summary: Verified bytes can be prepared for a separately authorized harness.
components.detail: Delivery is locally tested. End-to-end native loading and task success require further evidence; downloaded content grants no execution permission.

edges.label: Exact effect and current read set

views.title: Sign-in and subscription access
views.description: Website sign-in, payment, client authorization and intelligence qualification remain separate decisions.

components.title: Website connection
components.summary: Connect the implemented workspace with a scoped service credential.
components.detail: The same-origin website supports a service key or configured access token held in page memory. Automated account signup and live identity-provider consent remain incomplete. Local token checks do not prove end-user OAuth onboarding.

components.title: Hosted checkout or billing portal
components.summary: Local adapter checked; live provider checkout not qualified.
components.detail: The adapter binds the exact plan, customer and return address. Fifty-two local checks and eighteen detected mutants cover session creation and recovery. No live Stripe checkout or payment has been performed. A browser return is not payment evidence.

components.title: Verify and reconcile
components.summary: Validate the signature, deduplicate the event and reconcile current state.
components.detail: Stripe event timestamps are not an ordering guarantee. Durable pending state refuses access until a configured provider snapshot is reconciled. Local injected-provider tests are not live Stripe qualification.

components.title: Durable entitlement
components.summary: Persist the current access decision without overriding administrative revocation.
components.detail: The local SQLite domain preserves tenants, keys, exact grants and usage through restart. The website and protocol must consult this same authority.

components.title: Connect a scoped client
components.summary: Use the supported protocol and permissions to request intelligence.
components.detail: Real local HTTP and protocol clients are tested. External discovery, consent and authorization must be qualified with the selected provider and actual harness client.

edges.label: Choose a configured plan; local route checked
Signed event and current provider state

views.title: Harness preparation and local execution
views.description: Retrieval supplies material. The local runtime owns task authority, harness execution and acceptance.

components.title: Task and declared authority
components.summary: Bind the original task, files, budget and allowed effects.
components.detail: The public solve path preserves task intake and authority. Materials, provider credentials and execution permission do not come from a service subscription.

components.title: Governed Loop assignments
components.summary: Resolve typed graph relationships and separately scoped assignments.
components.detail: Local graph and provisioning integration checks exist. Broad unseen-task decomposition and complete internal paths still require additional evidence.

components.title: Prepare selected material
components.summary: Verify exact bytes and write only the permitted native layout.
components.detail: Path, overwrite, digest and guardrail checks are implemented. Complete service-to-native-harness materialization remains a combined integration gate.

components.title: Separate harness process
components.summary: Run an installed harness inside the declared workspace and authority.
components.detail: A mounted file is not proof the native harness loaded or used it. Exact installed harness, model route, cancellation and observed loading need live qualification.

components.title: Configured decision endpoints
components.summary: Jev, Circuit or a compatible endpoint, directly or through a harness tool.
components.detail: Users supply endpoint, model, locality, authentication reference and ordered routes. Loop Engine does not launch model services. Direct and protocol-tool paths have local fixture checks. Automatic Practitioner routing, actual model quality and complete context coverage remain unqualified; a judgment never grants authority or accepts a task.

components.title: Verification and Run History
components.summary: Record outputs and failures; accept only under the declared checks.
components.detail: Process completion, valid output and independently accepted task success remain separate. Failed attempts and unresolved effects are retained rather than silently replayed.

edges.label: Selected references and scoped write authority
Candidate judgment, not an acceptance verdict

views.title: Frontend, backend and account services
views.description: The browser renders the product interface. The Python backend owns authorization and delivery. Supabase and Stripe are external integrations, not substitutes for the application's access rules.

components.title: Browser frontend
components.summary: Workspace, catalogue search, downloads and setup pages.
components.detail: The packaged JavaScript calls the same-origin service. Its access token stays in page memory; model-provider keys are not collected by this website. Automated signup remains incomplete.

components.title: Python service boundary
components.summary: Versioned HTTP and Model Context Protocol operations.
components.detail: The implementation is locally checked. Fly deployment, exact hostname and live account interoperability are not yet qualified.

components.title: Authentication adapter
components.summary: Validate issuer, signature, audience and scope.
components.detail: Supabase Auth is the proposed identity provider. The backend resolves its own durable subject-to-tenant binding; a token cannot declare another tenant.

components.title: Tenant and entitlement domain
components.summary: Current grants, revocation, idempotency and acknowledged usage.
components.detail: Website and protocol calls share this authority. A browser success page does not grant subscription access.

components.title: Stripe subscription adapter
components.summary: Hosted checkout, portal, signed events and reconciliation.
components.detail: The adapter has local tests. Live accounts, automatic customer bootstrap and periodic reconciliation still need qualification.

components.title: Database and private bodies
components.summary: PostgreSQL metadata and indexes; private object storage.
components.detail: Current serving uses SQLite and local reviewed files. Engineering must implement the cloud adapters and qualify their transaction and disclosure behavior before this target is active.

edges.label: Verified event and current subscription state
